A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 8 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 8 epochs old, anchored at a orchard checkpoint. The attacker spends 163 dollars and 15 days per identity before it can vote at all.
